limitations: Does not cover infinite, cyclic or branching graphs, nonseparable potentials, or arbitrary perturbation norms; earlier priority outside checked literature is uncertain.
scientific_integrity: Finite real path; proof of universal pairwise weighted-variation contraction for separable finite convex edge energies and nonlinear subgradient flows, with explicit quadratic necessity witness. Independent assessment has not been conducted.
title: Universal weighted-variation contractivity of convex path resolvents and flows
